title: Alkem Laboratories Ltd - 539523 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

summary.headline: Alkem Q4 FY26 revenue rose 14.6% YoY to INR36,033 million and FY26 EBITDA crossed INR3,000 crore, with management guiding FY27 margins to 20-21%.
summary.overview: Q4 FY26 revenue from operations was INR36,033 million (+14.6% YoY), with India sales up 8.8% to INR23,245 million and international sales up 25.4% to INR12,223 million. Q4 EBITDA was INR5,174 million at a 14.4% margin, and FY26 EBITDA grew 32.2% YoY per management, with a 20.4% full-year margin. Q4 net profit was INR2,365 million after exceptional items of INR602.7 million (labour code gratuity/leave liability) and INR747 million (real estate impairment). Management flagged rising logistics, API and packaging costs from geopolitical disruption, and announced that CEO Dr. Vikas Gupta is leaving; a new CEO search is underway.

financial_highlights.change: Margin up from 12.4% in Q4 FY25 (as stated)

financial_highlights.value: INR3,052 million per slide (management also said crossed INR3,000 crore); margin 20.4%
financial_highlights.change: Margin up from 19.4% in FY25; EBITDA +19.6% YoY (stated), +32.2% (stated for Q4 context)

segments.name: India branded generics
segments.commentary: Q4 FY26 India sales grew 8.8% YoY to INR23,245 million; management said branded generics grew close to 10%. IQVIA shows Q4 growth of 11.1% vs IPM ~10%, with chronic +16.1% vs IPM 13.6% and acute +10% vs IPM 7.7%.

segments.name: International (US and ROW)
segments.commentary: Q4 international sales rose 25.4% YoY to INR12,223 million; FY26 international sales were INR4,610 million (+22.5%). Management did not split US and ROW figures for the quarter.

segments.name: Trade generics
segments.commentary: FY26 trade generics growth was about 4.3% on an annualised basis after the carve-out into a separate entity; management is prioritising margin over top-line.

segments.name: Enzene (CDMO/biologics)
segments.commentary: Enzene India is at a high-teens EBITDA margin; Enzene US is loss-making during ramp-up and the group is not expected to be EBITDA positive this year. US CDMO revenue was under INR100 crore last year.

segments.name: Medtech (Occlutech)
segments.commentary: Medtech contributes less than 1% of revenue today. Occlutech acquisition expected to close in 45-60 days.

guidance_outlook: India: grow 100-150 bps above the market; with the market growing ~9-10%, management called double-digit growth the target.
US (dollar terms): high single-digit growth on pharma, plus forex gain and new launches; Tolvaptan launch expected around Sep/Oct 2026 with limited competition.
ROW: higher-teens growth assumed for FY27.
FY27 EBITDA margin: 20-21% range (like-to-like), subject to geopolitical and cost clarity; management said it will know more by H2 or Q3.
R&D spend expected at 4-5% of revenue annually; Q4 runs higher (6-6.5%) because of filing cycle.
Other expenses expected to rise 7-8% in FY27, excluding the Occlutech acquisition.
Tax rate guided down to 27-29% from FY27 after moving to the new tax regime from April 2026 (previously 35-38%).
Dividend: 25-30% of PAT currently; management does not foresee a major cut in absolute dividend, so the payout ratio will rise as PAT rises.
capex_capacity: Enzene US biologics plant recently commissioned; ramp-up ongoing, no clear evidence yet of onetime asset turnover from US in-sourcing trend.
No further acquisitions planned for at least 12 months; Occlutech integration into Alkem MedTech expected to take about 12 months after closing.
Denosumab (Prolia/Xgeva) biosimilar under US FDA review; US launch not expected this year, possibly out-licensed.
Semaglutide: injectable approved and launched in India in March 2026; oral tablet in clinical trials; US filing planned in about 1.5 years.
demand_pricing: Q4 chronic branded generic growth 16.1% vs IPM 13.6%; outperformed in 6 key therapies: GI, vitamins and minerals, pain, antidiabetic, respiratory and dermatology.
Chronic is about 22% of India branded generics, up roughly 1 percentage point a year over 3-4 years.
Semaglutide launched day 1 in March 2026; about 11% unit market share in the latest IQVIA report.
Anti-infective market (oral liquids and injectables) remains muted; management said Alkem's acute growth is still high single-digit.
Domestic field force around 14,500 MRs at group level; attrition 18-19%.
Geopolitical environment has raised logistics, API and packaging costs; management hedges 80% of forex exposure and buys API and packaging inventory on price dips.

qa_highlights.question: What is the outlook for India growth and the margin path given cost pressure?
qa_highlights.answer: India is targeted at 100-150 bps above the market; FY26 margin of 20.4% is the baseline and FY27 is seen at 20-21%, with 100 bps annual expansion now a moving target.

qa_highlights.question: What is the Occlutech deal timing and the impact on numbers?
qa_highlights.answer: Deal expected to close in 45-60 days; if it closes, Q2 FY27 would carry a full quarter impact. Medtech is under 1% of revenue today.

qa_highlights.question: What is the Denosumab biosimilar timeline in the US and Europe?
qa_highlights.answer: US approval is possibly by Q1 CY27 subject to inspection; no launch this year. Europe has one partner for the Prolia biosimilar; the Xgeva version has no partner yet.

qa_highlights.question: What is the CEO succession and CXO plan?
qa_highlights.answer: A new CEO will be hired from top global candidates, taking a few months. Non-pharma group businesses (Occlutech, Enzene) report to other promoters or the MD.

qa_highlights.question: What is the Tolvaptan launch and expected contribution?
qa_highlights.answer: Launch expected around September or October 2026 as a limited-player launch, so contribution comes in H2 FY27; base US business faces value erosion.

qa_highlights.question: What are the plans for dividend and capital allocation?
qa_highlights.answer: Dividend is 25-30% of PAT; absolute payout is expected to be maintained, so the payout percentage will rise after the tax reset. No acquisitions for 12 months.

risks_watch: Input cost inflation (API, packaging, logistics) from geopolitical disruption; management will not quantify Q1 FY27 impact.
Management transition: Dr. Vikas Gupta departing; CEO search in progress and may take a few months.
Denosumab US approval and Europe partnering timing; Tolvaptan launch in Sep/Oct 2026.
Trade generics receivables risk and weak growth in FY26 (about 4.3%).
Enzene US ramp-up losses and CDMO revenue, which is expected to take a couple of years to reach INR200-300 crore.
Q4 other expenses rose about INR200 crore QoQ, partly one-time (due diligence, renovation) and partly forex-driven.
summary.management_tone: Confident on domestic execution and chronic/semaglutide momentum, but cautious on FY27 margins and cost inflation, with management repeatedly declining to quantify headwinds. Tone is measured on the US and Enzene timelines, which management says will take time.
key_quotes: We are confident that with our strong capabilities and adequate inventory built up, we are well positioned to mitigate the potential disruptions and ensure continuity of operations.
In the current scenario, it's a moving goalpost.
we don't foresee any major reduction in absolute value of dividend.
So, we want to revise our guidance on tax rate. The number will be around 27% to 29% going forward.

Occlutech medtech acquisition (not organic capacity; expected to close in 45-60 days)

growth.why: Management guides India growth 100-150bp above a ~9-10% market (double-digit target), US high single-digit in dollar terms plus Tolvaptan launch around Sep/Oct 2026, ROW higher-teens, and FY27 EBITDA margin 20-21%; backing is partial (Tolvaptan timing, Semaglutide launch, chronic outperformance) with no specific new capacity or order numbers, and margin guidance is explicitly subject to geopolitic

mgmt.note: CEO Dr. Vikas Gupta is leaving and a new CEO search is underway; no successor named and no growth plan stated by a new leader.
